steps.label: Both beat a custom form

eyebrow: The most expensive mistake in the field
code:
Wrong:  every vendor gets the same full questionnaire + review cycle
        -> low-risk vendors waste GRC time, high-risk vendors get rubber-stamped

Right:  tier first, THEN pick the review depth
        Tier 1 = full SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2/ISO review + audit rights
        Tier 2 = SIG Lite/CAIQ + targeted follow-up
        Tier 3 = light intake questionnaire only
caption: Assessment depth should match real risk, not treat every vendor identically.

steps.label: Data sensitivity
steps.sub: Regulated or confidential data touched, or none at all?

steps.label: Access level
steps.sub: Network, system, or physical access -- or a fully external service?

steps.label: High on both = Tier 1
steps.sub: A payroll processor with a direct system integration, for example

code:
Questionnaire answer alone   -> the vendor grading its own homework
+ SOC 2 Type II report       -> controls verified over a period of time
+ ISO 27001 cert + SoA       -> independently audited control scope
+ Pen test executive summary -> real testing evidence, not a claim
caption: A vendor that can't produce evidence when asked is itself a finding worth escalating.
